description: This file contains utility functions for managing Azure Queue storage within the Orleans streaming framework, including generating queue names, deleting queues, and clearing messages, primarily for testing and setup purposes.

classes.name: AzureQueueStreamProviderUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for managing Azure Queue streams, such as generating queue names, deleting, and clearing queues, specifically used within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: GenerateDefaultAzureQueueNames
methods.description: Generates a list of default Azure Queue names based on service ID and provider name using a hash ring-based queue mapper.

methods.name: DeleteAllUsedAzureQueues
methods.description: Deletes all specified Azure queues; overloaded to accept either a connection string or AzureQueueOptions.

methods.name: ClearAllUsedAzureQueues
methods.description: Clears all messages in specified Azure queues; overloaded to accept either a connection string or AzureQueueOptions.
